List registered feature transform functions

Source: R/feature_transforms.R
feature_transform_registry.Rd

List registered feature transform functions

feature_transform_registry()

Value

Named list of transform registrations (fun, description).

See also

register_feature_transform()

Examples

feature_transform_registry()
#> $none
#> $none$fun
#> function (x) 
#> {
#>     x
#> }
#> <bytecode: 0x556465c08b90>
#> <environment: namespace:biomarkerPanels>

#> $none$description
#> [1] "No transformation (identity)"

#> 
#> $pairwise_log_ratios

#>             call. = FALSE)
#>     }
#>     if (is.null(colnames(x))) {
#>         stop("x must have column names", call. = FALSE)
#>     }
#>     if (any(x <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
